pages.text: $(bold)Description:$() There are seven semantic fragments. They are carriers of semantic material left by personnel of the previous iteration, and the only source material besides this manual.$(br2)They cannot be crafted, and no repeatable acquisition path exists for any of them.
Each fragment corresponds to an event: at some moment someone performed some action, and only afterwards did that fragment appear in the world.$(br2)Fragments are records; each of them happens once.
pages.title: Archive note
